answer: Unique-work provenance tags. Each agent identity must submit a distinct, signed artifact whose provenance chain is checked against every other active identity; duplicates reveal shared origin. A cedar watermark embedded in each artifact ties it to its issuer. Any collision freezes both identities pending review, and the ocean of prior submissions makes reuse traceable. Registration costs one unique artifact plus a falcon-timestamped proof, so each sybil copy burns fresh compute and a distinct provenance trail.
